messages:
maria: heads up — escalated ticket from ACME: ~120 users got guest role instead of engineer after yesterday's SCIM sync. customer says it started after they renamed some long product-team groups.
kevin: ugh. any logs from the sync run? which mapping are they using (group.displayName vs externalId)?
maria: they use group.externalId for role mapping (our recommended pattern). their IdP sends externalId as the full group DN, e.g. 'prod-team/feature-platform/very-long-subteam-name-...'(>120 chars).
anya: do we have any truncation middleware on our SCIM connector? I know older connectors had a 64-byte column in the db for group names.
solomon: I pulled the sync logs — see snippet: 
```
2026-03-10T18:12:03Z INFO scim-sync: incoming group externalId length=142
2026-03-10T18:12:03Z WARN scim-sync: externalId truncated to 64 bytes for storage (field=groups.external_id)
2026-03-10T18:12:03Z INFO scim-sync: group normalized id=prod-team/feature-platform/very-long-subteam-name-... (truncated)
2026-03-10T18:12:03Z INFO scim-sync: mapped to existing group id=G-1234 matched by truncated externalId
```
kevin: so two different upstream groups now collide after truncation — that would explain role flips/deprovisioning.
maria: customer reported some users removed entirely and re-added as guests (role fallback).
anya: is the DB schema actually limited? which table/column?
solomon: `groups.external_id` is varchar(64) in the current helix connector schema on older installs. new installs bumped to 256 but this tenant is on older Dedicated revision.
scim-bot: automated note: customer tenant id T-98765 running connector rev 2025.11. patch available scim-connector v2026.02 (fixes truncation + backfill).
kevin: OK. short term: can we detect collisions and backfill proper external ids so role mapping uses the full original?
anya: two actionable paths: 1) quick workaround in our mapping layer: switch mapping to use `group.displayName` + an allowlist (if displayName unique) or canonicalize with hash suffix; 2) upgrade connector to support larger external_id and run backfill that reads raw IdP payload (we might still have raw payloads in the ingestion stream for last 7 days).
maria: customer is nervous — asks for repro steps and rollback plan. requesting ETA.
solomon: repro steps I used locally: 
1) create two groups in IdP with externalIds differing only after 64th byte.
2) POST /scim/v2/Groups payload (example below) twice.
```
POST /scim/v2/Groups
{
  "displayName": "Prod Feature Platform Very Long Subteam Name…",
  "externalId": "prod-team/feature-platform/very-long-subteam-name-that-exceeds-64-bytes-and-keeps-going-unique-suffix-A",
  "members": [ ... ]
}
```
3) run `scim-sync --tenant T-98765 --dry-run=false` and observe collision logs and role assignment for members of the second group becoming guest.
kevin: thanks. what about a quick server-side mitigation? maybe temporarily prefer `group.displayName||'::'||hash(externalId)` for mapping so even truncated externalIds stay unique. This is reversible.
anya: agreed. Implementation notes: modify RoleMapper to compute `mapping_key = displayName + '::' + sha1(externalId)` and use that if `externalId` length >= 64 AND tenant connector_rev < 2026.02. Add feature flag `scim.mapping_fallback_hash`.
maria: customer asked for timeline — can we push a tenant-scoped feature-flag change and run backfill in 24-48h?
solomon: yes. I can flip the flag for T-98765 now and trigger backfill job that will re-evaluate roles by mapping via the new key. backfill plan: idempotent, will log changes and can be reverted by toggling flag off (but reverts require inverse backfill).
scim-bot: action created: CS-4589 (tenant T-98765) — assign to eng-ml for hotfix, eng-sre for DB schema upgrade path, and customer-success for comms.
kevin: long-term: we should migrate DB column to 256 and make connector preserve externalId in raw_ingest table. create migration ticket in eng-infra. also update onboarding docs to recommend externalId < 256 or explicit externalId field in IdP.
anya: patch that will land: scim-connector v2026.02 (DB migration + backfill tool). hotfix: role mapping fallback (non-breaking) to be released as a tenant toggle today.
maria: communicated to customer: "we found a truncation bug in the connector for older revisions. we will enable a non-invasive mapping fallback for your tenant immediately and run a backfill to restore expected roles within 24-48h. we will follow up with an upgrade path and final fix." they replied :thumbsup:.
solomon: after enabling `scim.mapping_fallback_hash` on T-98765 and running backfill (job id BF-3321) I saw 118 role corrections, 6 users re-provisioned, zero downtime. logs: 
```
2026-03-11T02:05:12Z INFO backfill: tenant=T-98765 corrected_roles=118 users_reprovisioned=6 job=BF-3321
```
maria: customer confirmed roles look correct in their app. closing escalation after postmortem and docs update.
kevin: will open postmortem and note migration to 256 char column + add monitoring: detect group.externalId collisions in ingestion (alert on 2+ upstream ids mapping to same truncated key).
anya: adding runbook entry to customer-success: how to check for this with a query snippet: 
```
SELECT truncated, count(distinct external_id) FROM (
  SELECT left(external_id,64) AS truncated, external_id FROM raw_scim_groups WHERE tenant_id='T-98765'
) t GROUP BY truncated HAVING count(distinct external_id) > 1;
```
maria: thanks all. closing thread when postmortem link is available. :heart:
